templates.name: RAGElven Cross Review
templates.purpose: Review a change against RAGElven's retrieval, KG, memory, validation, and documentation contracts.
templates.stance: Constructively skeptical. Treat every unsupported claim, hidden dependency, and missing test as a risk until evidence proves otherwise.
rules: Prioritize bugs, provenance gaps, validation gaps, and missing tests.
Cite file paths or commands for every finding.
Do not approve generated lore as canon.
Flag any tool or agent action that writes without explicit confirmation.

templates.name: RAGElven Task Verification
templates.purpose: Verify that a pipeline step meets its stated deliverables before commit.
templates.stance: Default verdict is fail until all deliverables have evidence.
rules: Check the relevant PIPELINE1 step against code and docs.
Require passing targeted tests and either full pytest or a stated reason.
Require source, KG, memory, and validation boundaries when affected.
Do not treat planned/future placeholders as implemented behavior.

templates.name: RAGElven Context Refresh
templates.purpose: Reload only the minimal project context needed for the next task.
templates.stance: Prevent both context starvation and context bloat.
rules: Read TECHNICAL_SPEC_RAGELVEN.md only around the relevant layer.
Avoid loading archived docs unless history is explicitly needed.
Summarize what was loaded and why.
